inventory.description: Pure, host-testable products of Packages/VisualCore: VisualCoreMath, VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreScenes, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffectsGraph, VisualCoreDiagnostics, VisualCoreAudioDSP, VisualCorePersistence, VisualCoreParameters, VisualCoreExperience (+ VisualCoreTestSupport for test targets). iOS products of Packages/VisualCoreRendering: VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreEffects, VisualCoreUI, VisualCoreAudio, VisualCoreAutomation, VisualCoreExperienceHost. For Molecular Explorer (checked 2026-11-15): VisualCoreMath has Vec3, Mat4 and Quat (axis-angle, rotate, slerp) in Double, OrbitCamera (view, projection, project, ray), OrbitBounds and OrbitViewBounds (orbit, pan, zoom, clamp), NumericHygiene with NumericError, StableHash and Ray3/RayHit3 with ray-box, ray-sphere and ray-triangle casts and nearest (no ray-cylinder or ray-capsule); VisualCoreScenes has Mesh with MeshGenerators plane, cube and uvSphere(segments:rings:radius:) only, MeshBuilder under a MeshBudget, the shapes surface, revolution, extrusion, tube (a two-point capped tube is a cylinder) and bevelledBox, and the gesture recognizers (Drag, Pinch, Rotate, Tap) with GestureArbiter; VisualCorePersistence has DocumentStore, DocumentEnvelope, MigrationChain and NamedLibrary; VisualCoreExperience has ExperienceStorage with StorageQuota, SavedStateStore, StateDigest and ScenarioManifest; VisualCoreRendering has MeshRenderer (one directional Lambert light, ambient, per-vertex colours, MeshFog, one draw per item), DepthMeshPass, PrimitiveRenderer, ParticleRenderer (the only instanced draw: 2D quads through Camera2D) and ResourceRegistry. Missing in every framework product (grep 2026-11-15 for cylinder, capsule, xyz, atom, bond, covalent, angstrom): an element catalog, a molecule domain, a text-record parser, bond inference, instanced lit-mesh drawing, a ray-cylinder cast and a document-picker helper.

RenderHost (@MainActor) owns the EGL display, context and surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend (EGLDisplayProvider chooses an RGBA8 ES3 config with no guaranteed depth buffer, so the window surface is colour-only), the CAMetalLayer RenderView, the FrameScheduler (CADisplayLink) and context generations; pause/resume, replaceScene, recreateContext, renderOffscreen and destroy; scenes implement RenderScene setup/resize/render/teardown. All EGL and GL work runs on the main thread. Molecular Explorer's parsing, bond inference, display-mode rules and picking are GPU-free CPU work done on input or load before drawing; drawing reads the molecule and camera and never changes them. Depth comes from DepthMeshPass's owned off-screen target copied to the framebuffer, never from a changed window configuration; the experience adds no EGL or GL context of its own.

ResourceRegistry creates buffers, textures, programs and render targets under a ResourceBudget and rejects stale handles after a generation change; makeRenderTarget(depth: true) adds a 24-bit depth renderbuffer. ShaderProgram, ShaderBundle and ShaderLibrary (#include expansion with line maps) compile bundled GLSL; the vc/ library holds color, field, hash, noise, palette and sdf helpers. Pipeline = ShaderProgram + RenderState, applied by GLState.apply (RenderState.opaque3D: depth test and write, back-face culling). MeshRenderer draws one Mesh with Lambert lighting from one light direction plus an ambient fraction, in one colour or per-vertex colours, with optional MeshFog; DepthMeshPass draws a list of items (renderer, model transform, colour) with depth into an owned target and blits the colour to the framebuffer. ParticleRenderer's instancing (vcglDrawArraysInstanced, vcglVertexAttribDivisor in the internal DynamicVertexBuffer) draws unlit 2D quads only; instanced lit meshes are assessed under G-RENDER. PrimitiveRenderer, FullScreenShaderScene and the effects graph are available for backgrounds and overlays.

Mesh (positions, normals, uvs, UInt32 indices; plane, cube, uvSphere) and MeshBuilder under a MeshBudget with welding; shapes surface, revolution, extrusion, tube and bevelledBox; normals, MeshBounds, validation, digest. A bond cylinder is Mesh.tube(path: [a, b], radius:, sides:, caps: true, closed: false), tested as a closed capped straight tube (MeshShapeTests); one unit cylinder can be oriented per bond with Mat4.rotation(Quat), translation and scale. OrbitCamera with OrbitViewBounds gives orbit, pan and zoom in bounds; OrbitCamera.ray with Ray3.intersect(sphereCenter:radius:) and Ray3.nearest picks an atom; OrbitCamera.project places native labels. There is no ray-cylinder cast (bond picking is not in version 0.1) and no neighbour search for bond inference (G-DOMAIN).

DocumentStore writes versioned documents (DocumentEnvelope kind and schemaVersion) atomically under a byte cap (maxBytes, default 256 KiB) and migrates them forward through a MigrationChain, reporting damaged or newer files as problems instead of crashing; NamedLibrary keeps named documents; ExperienceStorage is the per-experience sandbox with StorageQuota (16 MiB, 64 files) and typed StorageError; SavedStateStore keeps small values. Recent molecules, visual settings, the camera and imported molecule copies use these (G-LIBRARY, G-IMPORT). No document-picker helper exists in a framework product: SwiftUI fileImporter is used only in the audio controls of A06-A08.

ExperienceSession opens, checkpoints, closes and recovers an Experience on one RenderHost, applies the quality level (QualityGovernor over the experience's QualityProfile, fed by DeviceConditions thermal state and Low Power Mode) and memory/scene-phase events, and renders stills; ExperienceShell adapts an ExperiencePresenter (scene, controls, canvas overlay) to Experience; ExperienceCore is the GPU-free state with its qualityTiers; ExperienceStorage is the per-experience sandbox; ExperienceFeedback routes haptics and announcements; ScenarioRunner replays a ScenarioManifest; the one app registers experiences in ExperienceRegistry and Catalog/registrations.json (fourteen registered, A01-A14, checked 2026-11-15; Molecular Explorer joins in A15-P01 and stays unregistered and unavailable in A15-P00; scripts/check_experience_packages.py forbids unregistered targets). Version 0.1 needs no permission: the XYZ import uses the system document picker (no usage string), so no privacy answer changes.

XcodeGen spec project.yml for the one app (target VisualCore), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, app tests via scripts/xcodebuild_app.py, and scripts/release_check.py: 128 named steps listed by --list on 2026-11-15 (shared checks including app-contracts, which checks every docs/apps/*/visualcore-contract.json, package and app builds/tests, experience-release and copy-claims steps, verify steps of A01-A14 on iOS 27 and 26, release audits of the one app, the seven reference regression steps and the ProjectM independence check).

Molecular Explorer owns its domain (the element catalog with symbol, name, atomic number, covalent and van der Waals radii in ångström and display colours, each with source and license; atoms, bonds and molecules with versioned schemas; the strict bounded XYZ parser and its typed refusals; distance-based bond inference marked as inferred; ball-and-stick and space-filling rules; atom picking and selection; labels, bond-order styling and the metadata panel; the curated small-molecule library with attributions; recent molecules, visual settings and the camera; the document-picker import; copy, data provenance and licenses) and UI under Packages/ExperiencesCreative/MolecularExplorer/ (Core GPU-free, CoreTests, Experience with Adapter/, ExperienceTests, Shaders, scenario-manifest.json; created in A15-P01, not present today). VisualCore owns reusable machinery: vectors, matrices, quaternions, the orbit camera and its bounds, ray casts and numeric hygiene (VisualCoreMath), meshes, shapes and gestures (VisualCoreScenes), mesh drawing and depth (VisualCoreRendering), persistence (VisualCorePersistence), storage, digests, quality and accessibility planning (constitution Principle II, A15 section). Solar System Explorer's presenter and picking code and the audio experiences' importers stay experience code and are not copied. ProjectM stays in the harness.

Reference pinned at d93edd1, read-only; scripts/run_reference_baseline.py lists the ordered reference steps; scripts/check_reference_clean.py checks the submodule; the 7 release-check steps run in two chunks via release_check.py --only (reference-engine-xcframework, reference-build-projectm-ios-sim, reference-clean; reference-test-anglerendering-ios27, reference-test-anglerendering-ios26, projectm-reference-ios27, projectm-reference-ios26), recorded with 7 of 7 passing (2026-11-15; .autonomy/checks/A15-P00.reference-1.json and reference-2.json) in the A15 regression baseline document with the phase-start commit fc60a33d (constitution aaeeb3a7).

StateDigest and StableHash fingerprint experience state so the same molecule, display mode, selection and camera give the same digest; ScenarioManifest and ScenarioRunner replay recorded steps; MeshBudget, ResourceBudget, StorageQuota, DocumentStore.maxBytes, QualityProfile and QualityGovernor bound vertex counts, GPU memory, storage and quality levels; NumericHygiene refuses or wraps non-finite values. Atom and bond caps, import size, line length and coordinate magnitude, the draw budget and the recent-list cap are Molecular Explorer's own limits (G-DOMAIN, G-PARSER, G-RENDER, G-LIBRARY).

matrix.capability: Instanced geometry: many atom spheres and bond cylinders (up to the experience's atom and bond caps) drawn per frame with correct occlusion through RenderHost on the main thread, one shared mesh per shape and quality level reused for every atom or bond by model transform, within a bounded draw budget
matrix.source: brainstorm: instanced geometry; constitution A15 reuse first (instanced or batched drawing)
matrix.notes: Tested: DepthMeshPassTests (the nearer of two meshes wins in both draw orders, on and off screen, recreated contexts match), MeshRendererTests, RenderHostTests, ParticleRendererTests. One MeshRenderer can be drawn many times with different model transforms (SolarPresenter draws its bodies that way), but every item is one draw call with its own uniforms: there is no instanced lit-mesh drawing in any framework product. Instancing exists only inside ParticleRenderer (vcglDrawArraysInstanced of 2D quads with vcglVertexAttribDivisor in the internal DynamicVertexBuffer, through Camera2D, unlit), which cannot draw lit 3D meshes. A molecule of a few hundred atoms and bonds is a few hundred draw items: batching over MeshRenderer and DepthMeshPass (shared meshes, merged static geometry per display mode, or per-element merged meshes) is G-RENDER (A15-P02); an instanced lit-mesh path is assessed there for VisualCoreRendering as an additive change to the same pipeline, never a second renderer. Built at A15-P02 (G-RENDER closed): the molecule scene, display modes and camera, tested in MoleculeSceneTests, CameraSettingsTests, MoleculeSceneRenderTests and MoleculeCameraTests.

matrix.capability: Materials: distinguishable per-element display colours (a conventional CPK-style palette with a recorded source) on lit procedural meshes without image files, a highlight for the selected atom, bonds coloured by their atoms' halves or a neutral colour
matrix.source: brainstorm: materials; constitution A15 visuals are code
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests (MeshRendererTests, MeshRendererColorTests for per-vertex colours, PipelineTests) and VisualCoreParametersTests (Palette). A uniform colour per draw or a per-vertex colour stream covers element colours, a highlight colour and two-colour bonds (a bond drawn as two half-cylinders). The element palette itself, with its source and license, is element-catalog data (G-ELEMENTS).

matrix.capability: Camera controls: perspective orbit camera around the molecule's centre, orbit, pinch zoom and pan inside bounds (pitch limit, distance range, target radius), touch recognizers with deterministic arbitration and a control alternative for every gesture
matrix.source: brainstorm: camera controls
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreMathTests (OrbitCameraTests, OrbitViewBoundsTests, CameraBoundsTests), VisualCoreScenesTests (GestureTests, GestureArbiterTests) and VisualCoreExperienceTests (GestureAlternativesTests). Framing a molecule by its bounding sphere, the reset view and persisting the camera apart from the molecule data are app work over OrbitCamera (G-CAMERA).

matrix.capability: Lighting: a directional light with an ambient floor so sphere and cylinder shading reads as 3D, the same in both display modes, with optional depth cueing by linear eye-depth fog
matrix.source: brainstorm: lighting
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests (MeshRendererTests, MeshFogTests, MeshRendererColorTests). MeshRenderer has one Lambert light and ambient; no specular term exists, which is enough for legible ball-and-stick shading (the manual asks for clear styling, not photorealism). A specular highlight would be an additive VisualCore change assessed in A15-P02 under G-RENDER only if the review shows it is needed.

matrix.capability: Structured scientific data visualization: an element catalog (symbol, name, atomic number, covalent and van der Waals radius in ångström, display colour, each with source and license) and an atom, bond and molecule domain with versioned schemas turned into a drawn, labelled 3D structure
matrix.source: brainstorm: structured scientific data visualization; constitution A15 data with provenance
matrix.notes: Grep 2026-11-15 for xyz, atom, bond, covalent and angstrom in Packages/VisualCore/Sources and Packages/VisualCoreRendering/Sources finds no domain type (only doc-comment words in Vectors.swift and Matrix.swift). Double vectors, numeric hygiene, stable hashing and the license inventory exist and are tested (LinearAlgebraTests, NumericHygieneTests, StableHashTests, AcknowledgementsViewTests). The element catalog and the molecule domain are chemistry content: G-ELEMENTS and G-DOMAIN, app-local (A15-P01), as Solar System Explorer's body catalog was. Built at A15-P01 (G-ELEMENTS, G-DOMAIN closed): the element catalog with sources and the molecule domain, tested in ElementsTests, ElementAuditTests and MoleculeTests.

matrix.capability: Curated small-molecule library with source attributions: a bounded set of bundled small molecules (coordinates in ångström) each with its name, formula, source, license and attribution shown in the app
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 1: curated small-molecule library with source attributions
matrix.notes: The license inventory and acknowledgements screen exist and are tested (AcknowledgementsViewTests), as does a named library of documents (NamedLibraryTests); none holds per-record scientific provenance. The curated molecules, their source records and the library UI are G-LIBRARY (app-local, A15-P04); the per-value source record type is shared with the element catalog (G-ELEMENTS, A15-P01). Built at A15-P04 (G-ELEMENTS, G-LIBRARY closed): the Library section lists the five PubChem molecules with name, formula, counts and "Source: PubChem Compound CID …, 3D conformer — public domain", tested in MoleculeLibraryUITests.

matrix.capability: Ball-and-stick and space-filling display modes: atoms as spheres scaled by a fraction of the covalent radius joined by bond cylinders, or as spheres at the van der Waals radius without bonds; switching modes changes drawing only, never the molecule
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 2: ball-and-stick and space-filling modes
matrix.notes: Spheres, capped straight tubes (a cylinder is Mesh.tube along two points with caps; MeshShapeTests straightCappedTubeAtThreeResolutions checks a closed capped straight tube's area and volume), the mesh builder under a budget and tessellation choice per quality level exist and are tested (MeshDigestTests, MeshShapeTests, MeshBuilderTests, TessellationChoiceTests). The mode rule (radius per mode, bonds hidden in space-filling) is G-DISPLAY (app-local, A15-P03) over the geometry of G-RENDER. Built at A15-P02 (G-RENDER, G-DISPLAY closed): the molecule scene, display modes and camera, tested in MoleculeSceneTests, CameraSettingsTests, MoleculeSceneRenderTests and MoleculeCameraTests.

matrix.capability: Touch orbit, pan, zoom and atom picking: one-finger orbit, two-finger pan, pinch zoom, a tap turned into a camera ray tested against each atom's display sphere (nearest hit first, radius per display mode) and a control alternative that steps through atoms
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 3: touch orbit, pan, zoom and atom picking
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreMathTests (RayIntersectionTests: ray-sphere, ray-box and ray-triangle hits against analytic results, nearest; OrbitCameraTests ray; OrbitViewBoundsTests pan) and VisualCoreScenesTests/GestureTests. No ray-cylinder or ray-capsule test exists, so bonds are not pickable by an existing cast; v0.1 needs atom picking only. Atom picking over Ray3 with the display-mode radius, the stepping control and the selection state are G-PICK (app-local, A15-P03); a generic ray-capsule cast is assessed there for VisualCoreMath if bond picking is added. Framing and the persisted camera are G-CAMERA (A15-P02). Built at A15-P03 (G-CAMERA, G-PICK closed): picking, gestures, labels, bond styles and the panel, tested in AtomPickerTests, LabelLayoutTests, BondStyleTests, MoleculeGestureTests, MoleculePickingTests and MoleculePanelTests.

matrix.capability: Element labels, bond types and a metadata panel: element symbols drawn or listed next to atoms without overlap, bond order (single, double, triple, aromatic or inferred) shown by style and text, a native panel with the molecule's name, formula, atom and bond counts, source and the selected atom's element and position
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 4: element labels, bond types and metadata panel
matrix.notes: Projection to the screen (OrbitCameraTests), the canvas overlay slot (CanvasOverlayTests), non-colour state signs and announcements (AccessibilityPlansTests) exist and are tested. Label placement, bond-order styling and the metadata panel are G-PANEL (app-local, A15-P03); the bond order values come from G-DOMAIN. Built at A15-P03 (G-DOMAIN, G-PANEL closed): picking, gestures, labels, bond styles and the panel, tested in AtomPickerTests, LabelLayoutTests, BondStyleTests, MoleculeGestureTests, MoleculePickingTests and MoleculePanelTests.

matrix.capability: Small XYZ file import with strict bounds and parser errors: a chosen .xyz text file parsed by a pure bounded parser, refused with a typed reason (too large, too many atoms, line too long, unknown element, malformed or non-finite value, count mismatch) and changing nothing on refusal, a valid file copied into the experience's own storage
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 5: small XYZ file import with strict bounds and parser errors
matrix.notes: Numeric hygiene with typed errors and per-experience storage with quotas exist and are tested (NumericHygieneTests, ExperienceStorageTests). No text-record parser exists in any framework product (only the private splitLines of ShaderLibrary). The XYZ parser is G-PARSER (app-local, A15-P01; a generic bounded line-record reader is assessed for VisualCore there); the picker, security-scoped read and copy are G-IMPORT (A15-P05). The example is the closest consumer: ScopeControls uses SwiftUI fileImporter for audio.

matrix.capability: Local recent molecules and visual settings: a bounded most-recent list (library and imported molecules), display mode, label and colour settings and the camera, each a versioned document in the experience's own storage with migration, damaged or newer files refused without a crash
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 6: local recent molecules and visual settings
matrix.notes: Versioned documents with migration, envelopes, named libraries, saved state and per-experience storage exist and are tested (DocumentStoreTests, NamedLibraryTests, ExperienceStorageTests, SavedStateStoreTests). The recent list, the settings and camera schemas and their caps are G-LIBRARY (app-local, A15-P04). Built at A15-P04 (G-LIBRARY closed): recent.json (at most 8, newest first) and settings.json (label mode) at schema 1 with typed refusals, tested in RecentMoleculesTests, MoleculeSettingsTests, RecentStoreTests and SettingsStoreTests; display mode and camera stay in the engine state (schema 3, migrated from 1 and 2); element colours are fixed, not a setting; imported molecules join the list at A15-P05.

matrix.capability: Strict bounded XYZ parsing with typed errors: fixed limits for file size, atom count, line length and coordinate magnitude; the comment line kept as untrusted text; unknown element symbols, non-finite numbers and count mismatches refused with a typed reason; pure, GPU-free and fuzzed
matrix.source: cross-cutting: strict bounded parsing; constitution A15 strict, bounded import; manual algorithm decisions
matrix.notes: Finite-value checks and byte caps on stored documents exist and are tested (NumericHygieneTests, DocumentStoreTests, ExperienceStorageTests); nothing parses text records. The parser, its caps and refusal reasons are G-PARSER (app-local, A15-P01); the fuzz and malformed-input corpus is G-IMPORT (A15-P05). The example is the closest consumer of bounded decoding with typed refusals (SavedView.decode).

matrix.capability: Inferred bonds labelled as estimates: bonds inferred from interatomic distance and covalent radii with a stated tolerance, bounded by atom count (spatial bucketing), always marked inferred in the drawing, panel and spoken text and never presented as measured
matrix.source: cross-cutting: inferred-bond labelling; constitution A15 strict import (inferred bonds); manual domain rule
matrix.notes: Vectors, numeric hygiene, state signs and announcements exist and are tested (LinearAlgebraTests, NumericHygieneTests, AccessibilityPlansTests). No neighbour search or spatial grid exists in a framework product. Distance-based bond inference with its provenance flag is G-DOMAIN (app-local, A15-P01); its labelling in the panel and speech is G-PANEL (A15-P03). Built at A15-P03 (G-DOMAIN, G-PANEL closed): picking, gestures, labels, bond styles and the panel, tested in AtomPickerTests, LabelLayoutTests, BondStyleTests, MoleculeGestureTests, MoleculePickingTests and MoleculePanelTests.

matrix.capability: Determinism: the same molecule, display mode and camera give the same parse result, bonds, picking result and digest on every run; parsing, inference, picking geometry and display rules run without a GPU; drawing never changes the state
matrix.source: cross-cutting: determinism; constitution A15 deterministic, GPU-free rules
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreExperienceTests (StateDigestTests, ScenarioManifestTests) and VisualCoreMathTests (StableHashTests, NumericHygieneTests).

matrix.capability: Persistence with migration: every stored document (recent list, settings, camera, imported molecule copies) versioned, written atomically, migrated forward and refused when damaged or newer
matrix.source: cross-cutting: persistence with migration; constitution A15 offline-first and private
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCorePersistenceTests (DocumentStoreTests, NamedLibraryTests) and VisualCoreExperienceTests (ExperienceStorageTests, SavedStateStoreTests). The schemas are G-LIBRARY.

matrix.capability: Quality tiers and low power: the governor fed by thermal state and Low Power Mode, declared tiers that lower sphere and cylinder segments and the draw budget
matrix.source: cross-cutting: quality tiers and low power; constitution A15 bounded
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreDiagnosticsTests (QualityGovernorTests, QualityProfileTests, TessellationChoiceTests), VisualCoreExperienceTests (QualityDeclarationTests) and VisualCoreExperienceHostTests (SessionQualityTests). Core.qualityTiers must match the presenter's levels (declared at the X follow-through).

matrix.capability: Accessibility with Reduce Motion and colour-independent element identity: system preferences observed, camera moves calmed or cut, the molecule, selected atom with its element and the display mode spoken, element symbols shown and spoken so identity never depends on colour, contrast checked, a control for every gesture
matrix.source: cross-cutting: accessibility; constitution A15 accessibility
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreSimulationTests (AccessibilityPreferencesTests, AccessibilityPlansTests), VisualCoreUITests (SystemAccessibilityObserverTests, AccessibilityPlayersTests, AccessibilitySettingsSectionTests for the WCAG contrast ratio) and VisualCoreExperienceTests (GestureAlternativesTests). The spoken wording and element-symbol labels are experience copy (G-PANEL).

matrix.capability: Lifecycle and context loss: context loss, resize, background and memory warning rebuild every mesh and buffer from versioned CPU state; the molecule and selection survive
matrix.source: cross-cutting: lifecycle and context loss; constitution A15 resilient GPU state
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreRenderingTests (RenderHostTests, ResourceRegistryTests, DepthMeshPassTests recreated context, MeshRendererTests recreation), VisualCoreExperienceHostTests (SessionPhaseMemoryTests, ShellLifecycleTests) and VisualCoreSimulationTests/PlaybackStateTests.

matrix.capability: Data provenance and licenses: every bundled element property and molecule records source, units (ångström) and license; only openly licensed or public-domain data is bundled; checked by a test and listed in the acknowledgements
matrix.source: cross-cutting: data provenance and licenses; constitution A15 data with provenance, licenses
matrix.notes: The license inventory exists and is tested (AcknowledgementsViewTests); it records code and asset licenses, not per-value source and units. The source record and its test are G-ELEMENTS (A15-P01) and G-LIBRARY (A15-P04); the data review is G-REVIEW (A15-P05); all app-local.

matrix.capability: File import through the system document picker without permissions: only the file the person chooses is read, with security-scoped access, size checked before reading, copied into the experience's own storage; no usage description, no privacy answer change
matrix.source: cross-cutting: file import without permissions; spec clarification 4
matrix.notes: Per-experience storage with quotas exists and is tested (ExperienceStorageTests). No document-picker helper exists in a framework product: SwiftUI fileImporter appears only in experience controls (ScopeControls, OdysseyControls, MusicLabControls, all for audio), and security-scoped reads only in VisualCoreAudio's file sources. The picker, scoped read and copy are G-IMPORT (app-local, A15-P05).

matrix.capability: Truthful claims: structures are illustrative models from stated sources, radii and colours are display conventions with their source, inferred bonds say so; no chemical safety, toxicity, medical or therapeutic claim; performance numbers only from device measurements
matrix.source: cross-cutting: truthful claims; constitution A15 truthful claims
matrix.notes: State signs, announcements and the license inventory exist and are tested (AccessibilityPlansTests, AcknowledgementsViewTests). The copy review and the generated data review are G-REVIEW (app-local, A15-P05); the release copy-claims step checks store copy.

matrix.capability: Sphere and cylinder geometry for atoms and bonds: a UV sphere per quality level and a capped cylinder along a unit axis, oriented and scaled per bond by a model matrix from a quaternion, under a mesh budget
matrix.source: cross-cutting: geometry; spec FR-A15-003 sphere and cylinder geometry
matrix.notes: Tested in VisualCoreScenesTests (MeshDigestTests and MeshBoundsTests build uvSphere; MeshShapeTests straightCappedTubeAtThreeResolutions builds Mesh.tube along a straight path with caps, a closed capped cylinder, and checks its area and volume; MeshBuilderTests budgets) and VisualCoreMathTests/LinearAlgebraTests (Quat(axis:angle:), Mat4.rotation, translation, scale). Mesh.tube(path: [a, b], radius:, sides:, caps: true, closed: false) is a capped cylinder, so no new generator is required; a named Mesh.cylinder convenience is optional and assessed in A15-P02 (G-RENDER) only if a second consumer appears.

matrix.capability: Bounded content: fixed caps for atom and bond counts, mesh detail, draw items, the recent list and import size; documents beyond a cap refused, never truncated silently
matrix.source: cross-cutting: bounded; constitution A15 bounded
matrix.notes: Mesh and resource budgets, storage quotas and document byte caps exist and are tested (MeshBuilderTests, ResourceLedgerTests, ExperienceStorageTests, DocumentStoreTests). The molecule caps are G-DOMAIN and G-PARSER (A15-P01), the draw budget per quality level G-RENDER (A15-P02), the recent-list cap G-LIBRARY (A15-P04). Built at A15-P04 (G-LIBRARY closed): the recent list is capped at 8 ids and 2,048 bytes and the settings at 1,024 bytes; a longer list is refused as out-of-range, never truncated (RecentMoleculesTests).

gaps.justification: No element catalog or per-value source record exists in any framework product. The elements Molecular Explorer supports (symbol, name, atomic number, covalent radius, van der Waals radius in ångström, display colour), each value with source, units and license, and the source record type shared with the curated library are chemistry content and stay in the experience's GPU-free Core (clarification 5, manual phase 01, A15-P01). Built at A15-P01: Core/Elements.swift, SourceRecord.swift and ElementAudit.swift (ten elements, 50 source records, audit and the generated data-sources.md).
gaps.test: Core host tests (swift test, no GPU): the bundled catalog decodes; symbols and atomic numbers are unique and consecutive for the supported range; every value has source, units (ångström for radii) and license from the allowed set; radii are finite and positive; missing-source, duplicate and non-finite entries are refused with a typed reason; a generated data-sources document matches the catalog

gaps.justification: No atom, bond or molecule type exists in any framework product. The molecule domain (atoms with element and position in ångström, bonds with order and a provenance flag measured/curated or inferred, molecule metadata), its versioned schema, its caps, and distance-based bond inference from covalent radii with a stated tolerance and spatial bucketing are the experience's rules (clarification 5, manual phase 01 atom/bond domain, A15-P01); a generic spatial grid is assessed for VisualCoreMath there if a second consumer exists. Built at A15-P01: Core/Molecule.swift (caps and refusals, Hill formula) and BondInference.swift (covalent radii plus 0.4 Å, inferred bonds single and marked); inferred connectivity equals the recorded bonds on all five curated molecules.
gaps.test: Core host tests: domain round-trip through the versioned schema; caps on atoms and bonds refused with a typed reason; inference on fixture molecules (water, methane, ethanol, benzene) gives the expected bonds within the tolerance and marks every inferred bond as inferred; inference time grows linearly on a bounded synthetic grid; the same input gives the same bonds and digest

gaps.justification: Nothing in a framework product parses text records (ShaderLibrary's splitLines is private and unbounded). The strict XYZ parser (atom-count line, comment line kept as untrusted text, one atom per line, fixed limits on bytes, atoms, line length and coordinate magnitude, typed refusals that change nothing) is pure and app-local (clarification 5, manual phase 01 strict parser, A15-P01). The constitution asks for a reusable bounded text-record reader in VisualCore if it proves generic; A15-P01 assesses that and records the outcome here. Built at A15-P01: Core/XYZParser.swift (limits and twelve typed refusals; the regression fixtures refuse a negative count, a NaN and a 65,537-byte file). The VisualCore line reader was assessed and kept app-local: this experience is its only consumer.
gaps.test: Core host tests: valid fixtures parse to the expected atoms; every refusal reason is produced by a minimal input (too many bytes, too many atoms, line too long, count mismatch, unknown element, malformed or non-finite number, magnitude beyond the cap, empty file); refusals leave state unchanged; CRLF and trailing whitespace accepted; a bounded seeded fuzz run never crashes and stays within the caps

gaps.justification: MeshRenderer and DepthMeshPass draw one item per call; the molecule scene does not exist: shared sphere and cylinder meshes per quality level, per-bond transforms (two half-bonds per bond for two-colour bonds), batching (merged static geometry per display mode and element, or shared meshes drawn per item) under a draw budget, and camera framing of the molecule's bounding sphere. App-local over MeshRenderer, DepthMeshPass, Mesh.uvSphere and Mesh.tube (clarification 5, manual phase 02 camera/atom/bond renderer, A15-P02). Instanced lit-mesh drawing is assessed there for VisualCoreRendering as an additive change on the same pipeline (never a second renderer); a named cylinder generator for VisualCoreScenes only if reusable. If either is added the owner becomes VisualCore and the reference regression runs at the X gate.
